back: Converting a.c. into a current in one direction only.
One diode in series with the load: one half-cycle passes, the other is blocked; output has gaps.
Four diodes; two opposite diodes conduct in each half-cycle; load current always in the same direction; no gaps.
In parallel with the load: charges to the peak, discharges through the load between peaks.
Make RC ≫ time between peaks: larger C, larger load resistance, or full-wave rectification.

front: Peaks per second from a 50 Hz supply
back: Half-wave: 50 (20 ms apart). Full-wave: 100 (10 ms apart).
Step-down transformer → bridge rectifier → smoothing capacitor → regulator.
Each silicon diode drops about 0.7 V; a bridge loses about 1.4 V from the peak.
